blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu – Morning and afternoon classes in public schools in Minglanilla, Cebu, will be shortened to four hours per session starting Monday, Nov. 16, until further notice. Mayor Lheslen Enad said public schools that have shifted to the 8 a.m. to 3 p.m. schedule may choose whether to retain the adjusted schedule or adopt the shortened class hours. Administrators of private schools, meanwhile, are given the discretion to decide whether to adopt the adjusted schedule.
